## Implementation status (re-review is post-implementation)
This slice's cutover is IMPLEMENTED and committed (Gerrit 1890, stacked on the C3 chain) and lives in the worktree this plan is re-reviewed against. The 23 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows enumerated below were recorded by slice C1 for the llm subsystem (`src/rebar/llm/`) subsystem and are REMOVED by this slice's commit — so a re-review reading the current `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py` registry will correctly observe ZERO rows for these paths and the ownership gate passing with no path-glob exception. That drained state is this slice's INTENDED END STATE, not a missing prerequisite; the enumeration below is the historical C1-recorded worklist this slice discharges. No further code change is proposed beyond what is already committed.

## Context / Problem
Slice C1 (ticket 29a9-3cf7-3ded-42d8) recorded 23 below-seam ambient config reads in the LLM subsystem (llm/, llm/plan_review/, llm/workflow/) as rows in `config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS`, below the composition seam enforced by the in-process AST gate `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent: 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab. Every one of the 23, when drained, is STILL FLAGGED (owner=composition in a non-composition-root file) — zero already-owned reads.

The 23 flagged reads (path :: symbol), relative to `src/rebar/llm/`:
- `load_config` (12): code_review/workflow_ops.py, completion.py, enrich_drain.py, plan_review/__init__.py, plan_review/det_floor.py, plan_review/drift_floor.py, plan_review/pin_health.py, plan_review/workflow_ops.py, plan_review/xcheck.py, workflow/completion_banking.py, workflow/gate_dispatch.py, workflow/gate_ops.py.
- gate_source.py :: REBAR_GATE_REF, REBAR_GATE_SOURCE, os.environ.get (the `_str_pref` dynamic read feeding `default_ref`/`default_source`).
- plan_review/sizing.py :: REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET. usage_log.py :: REBAR_USAGE_LOG. workflow/completion_banking.py :: REBAR_ROOT. workflow/criterion_preview.py :: REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT.
- gate_context.py :: REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED. workflow/gate_ops.py :: REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH. workflow/executor.py :: os.environ[...]. workflow/interpreter.py :: os.environ[...].

Affected SOURCE files: the 21 above plus `src/rebar/config.py` (owned resolvers) and `scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py` (removes the 23 rows). `llm/anthropic_model.py`/`bedrock_model.py` are already composition roots, NOT touched.

## Outcome
Each read gets exactly one treatment and its `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` row is removed. `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` reports zero findings for these paths, no path-glob exception. Behavioral suites stay green; redacted operation-snapshot fingerprints unchanged except deltas recorded on this ticket.

## Decision rule
- **(a) CUT-TO-SEAM (default; 19 reads).** A read whose value is composed config is CUT: routed through an OWNED `config.py` resolver (reuse `compose_config()`; add narrow resolvers) and threaded into the below-seam helper, whose signature changes to RECEIVE the value. The ambient `os.environ`/`load_config` no longer exists below the seam. **Preserve resolution timing:** a read resolved LIVE per operation is cut to a resolver that ALSO reads live per call (re-reads env>file>default each call), NOT composed once and threaded — else a mid-operation env override is silently lost.
- **(b) OWNED-IN-PLACE via per-LINE `# read-via:` marker (bounded allowlist ONLY; 4 reads).** A read that is NOT composed config — a subsystem kill-switch or subprocess/protocol env-control — stays with a marker naming the category. The gate flags each accessed LINE; these 4 reads = exactly **4 marked lines**, each a single-line access (the `var not in os.environ` membership checks are `Compare` nodes the gate does not flag — only the `os.environ[...]` subscript is). No other listed read may be marked.

### Owned-in-place allowlist (4 reads = 4 marked lines — the cap)
1. `llm/gate_context.py` L201 `REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED` — subsystem kill-switch: logged, audited escape hatch letting agentic file access run outside the snapshot-gate session. 1 line.
2. `llm/workflow/gate_ops.py` L196 `REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` — kill-switch toggle disabling verify prefetch for the story-a9dd A/B baseline. 1 line.
3. `llm/workflow/executor.py` L442 `os.environ[...]` — workflow-expression env interpolation: expands `${VAR}` named by a workflow spec (protocol env-control, dynamic var), raising if unset. 1 line.
4. `llm/workflow/interpreter.py` L206 `os.environ[...]` — same `${VAR}` interpolation. 1 line.

## Plan
1. Add/confirm owned `config.py` resolvers: reuse `compose_config()` and the owned `_config_sources.resolve_run_root(explicit)` for completion_banking's run-scoped scratch base — precedence explicit>REBAR_ROOT>`Path.cwd()`, with **NO git-toplevel step and NOT realpath-normalized**, mirroring the current `CriterionBank._open`/`for_run` fallback verbatim so the bank dir (`.rebar/workflow_runs/<run>/bank`) and the repo-leak guard are byte-for-byte unchanged. This is deliberately NOT `repo_root()`, whose explicit>REBAR_ROOT>git-toplevel>cwd precedence would relocate the bank to the git toplevel when invoked from a subdir with REBAR_ROOT unset (a fingerprint delta we explicitly avoid); add live-per-call `resolve_gate_ref(root)`/`resolve_gate_source(root)` (move `gate_source._str_pref` into the owned seam, env>`[snapshot]`>default), `resolve_plan_review_budget()`, `resolve_usage_log_sink()`, `resolve_preview_timeout()` — each preserving exact precedence/clamping, live per call.
2. Cut the 19 composed-config reads to route through those resolvers, changing below-seam helper signatures to RECEIVE the value (or call the resolver INTERNALLY where a signature must stay fixed). The 12 `load_config` reads thread the composed verify config from the gate's per-operation composition point (an env override still misses `load_config`'s env-signature cache).
3. Mark the 4 owned-in-place reads with `# read-via:` markers; no other markers. Remove the 23 rows from `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS`. Run the gate + regression set; keep green.

## Affected TEST consumers (updated in-scope — inject via the new signature/resolver, keep assertions)
- REBAR_GATE_REF/SOURCE: tests/unit/{test_code_review_ws4, test_external_tier_gate_ref, test_external_tier_live_reachability, test_subcall_class_selection}; tests/interfaces/{lifecycle/test_ref_coherence, store/test_gate_source_threading, store/test_llm_optionality, store/test_agent_op_safeguard}.
- REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET: tests/unit/{test_plan_review_reuse, test_plan_review, workflow/test_pass1_warmup, workflow/test_production_batch_runner}; tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_plan_review_gate.
- REBAR_USAGE_LOG: tests/unit/{test_usage_log_attribution, test_usage_log_run_shape_aec1, test_rp01_s3_contract_oracle, test_agent_call_seam, test_ci_provider_matrix, test_reviewbot_bedrock_cutover, workflow/test_code_review_usage_attribution, workflow/test_code_review_verdict_provenance}.
- REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT: tests/unit/test_criterion_preview. REBAR_ROOT: completion-banking suites setting REBAR_ROOT to redirect the run-scoped scratch dir.
Where a cut changes a shared helper signature, its call sites are re-derived (Serena `find_referencing_symbols` + a string `grep`) and brought into scope, OR the helper reads the resolver internally (signature unchanged).

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
Timing + oracle in one held-out `tests/scripts/test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py` (imports gate scripts by BARE name: `import check_config_ownership`) asserts: (i) `check(check_config_ownership.REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding containing any of the 21 listed paths; (ii) `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` has zero entries whose `path` is a listed file; (iii) `# read-via:` markers across the listed files total exactly 4, confined to gate_context.py (1), workflow/gate_ops.py (1), workflow/executor.py (1), workflow/interpreter.py (1) — every other file 0 — so blanket-marking can't substitute for cutting. RED now. Plus a timing regression: a per-op override of the five cut env vars applied mid-run is still observed after the cut (proves live-per-call, not compose-once).
Regression suites kept green: tests/unit/plan_review, tests/unit/workflow, tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py, lifecycle plan-review/gate suites, plus every affected consumer above.

## Portability & rollback
The gate is in-process AST (no CI-provider trigger); resolvers and markers add no CI dependency. No stored format changes — cut-to-seam is routing/threading through owned resolvers. Rollback = revert the change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No ambient config read remains below the seam in the 21 listed files: 19 cut-to-seam through owned `config.py` resolvers (live-per-call where the original was live); the 4 enumerated owned-in-place reads carry a per-line `# read-via:` marker (4 lines); no other read marked.
- [ ] The 23 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows removed and `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception, proven by the held-out `test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py` incl. its marker-total==4 / per-file-placement check.
- [ ] The Testing regression suites pass after the cutover, including the live-per-call timing regression; operation-snapshot fingerprints unchanged except deltas recorded as a comment on this ticket.
